posts.text:
“Trump is trying to rewrite the Iran deal on the battlefield” 
 
The escalation in Lebanon, the confrontation over the Strait of Hormuz, the refusal to unfreeze Iran’s assets, the removal of oil sanctions waivers, and the resumption of military attacks are not separate disputes. Together, they represent an effort to alter the practical terms of the MoU after it was signed.
